course_name_original: Computer aided maintenance of the stock of machines
course_name_en: Computer aided maintenance of the stock of machines

learning_outcomes.text: The student possesses basic knowledge necessary to understand the ex-technical conditions of engineering activity, possesses basic knowledge on management, including quality management and running commercial enterprise, within the range of protection of intellectual property and patent law; knows general principles of creating and developing forms of individual entrepreneurship and basic HSE rules applicable to machine industry. The student describes the safety requirements at workplaces in a production plant, the principles of ensuring compliance with legal requirements and the use of computer support in the area of compliance.
The student has knowledge of the maintenance and repair of CNC machine tools and other machines and devices used in production.
The student describes the categories of software used to support maintenance in production plants, their purpose and basic functionality.
The student describes the principles of selecting an effective maintenance strategy for a machine park in a production plant.

syllabus_topics: Tasks of the fleet maintenance system in modern production plants
OEE and other indicators used to evaluate the effectiveness of a plant maintenance system
Organisational solutions and the principles of their selection, taking into account the specificity of a production plant
Typical strategies maintenance and principles of their selection
Categories of software for computer aided maintenance and their areas of application
Application of design of experiment (DOE) in machining: black box theory, the meaning of inputs and outputs, statistical calculations, Latin and Greco-Latin square method
Application of CMMS software in the management of maintenance activities - data collection, scheduling of inspection and maintenance work
Computer-aided measurement and data acquisition (DAQ) - applicability of Labview and DasyLab software in maintenance of production equipment
Monitoring of machines and production processes using HMI/SCADA systems - recording of time and machine downtime
Development of maintenance plans for CNC machine tools, part 1
Development of maintenance plans for CNC machine tools, part 2
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the final test is 56.0%. The exercises component requires 100.0% to pass.
